_comment: Reputation for historic play (§9), the Chapter 1 stand-in until Phase 2's full version (Academic Quality, outcomes, rankings). Quality (0-100) is a weighted mix of what the player can already shape; Reputation drifts toward it (§32 'Reputation drift': 10% of the gap a year, applied monthly) and scales applicants. Every number is a [TWEAK] placeholder.
_weights_comment: Quality components (weights are normalised): teaching = faculty's mean teaching score; faculty_ratio = 100 at the era's student/faculty ratio, less when there are more students per professor; housing = share of students in university halls; classrooms = 100 while seats are at most classroom_comfort full, 0 when full; dining = steward's hall places per student; happiness = students' mean happiness; heritage = Heritage earned (projects on their real sites, the Slant Walk) out of heritage_for_full.
_applicants_comment: Applicants x (1 + per_point x (Reputation - Reputation at the start)), clamped. The start scenario's applicant numbers are the baseline.
